author: ojiudezue
title: EC solar daily delta switched to the Envoy CT counter after the lifetime counter was shown to flap
summary: EC solar daily delta switched to the Envoy CT counter after the lifetime counter was shown to flap
why: Operator asked to confirm it was not a cumulative non-issue. Measured: envoy lifetime_energy_production flaps to 0.046 MWh (32 drops since 09-20; other lifetime legs 0), so day deltas were silently 0.0 on 5 of 40 days and NULL on 31, understating consumption that trains the forecast. CT counter is monotonic and agrees when healthy. Review A found rejected days fell back to a net-import-only consumption that still trained learners; fixed to write NULL and learn nothing.
implications: Rejected production days record NULL solar and consumption, never a wrong number. LIFETIME_PRODUCTION_MAX_DROP_FRACTION=0.5 guard is in-memory; a genuine counter reset rejects days until the next restart. Past solar rows are not repaired (backfill script only covers Emporia legs).
revisit_trigger: First midnight after deploy: energy_daily solar matches CT daily delta within 1%.
